item.title: This St. Louis restaurant named one of America’s most romantic
item.description: A longtime St. Louis staple has earned national recognition for being one of America’s most romantic restaurants, just in time for Valentine’s Day.

item.title: MLB to produce, distribute St. Louis Cardinals games in 2026
item.description: MLB will produce and distribute all in-market games for the St. Louis Cardinals during the 2026 season, with fans able to watch on traditional cable and satellite providers, as well as through MLB's direct-to-consumer streaming platform, Cardinals.TV.

item.title: $2M lottery ticket sold at Gas Mart in St. Louis
item.description: A big win has already been claimed in the Missouri Lottery’s “40th Anniversary” Scratchers game. The game’s first $2 million top prize was sold at Gas Mart, located at 710 Goodfellow Blvd. in St. Louis.

item.title: St. Louis Cardinals trade Brendan Donovan to Seattle Mariners
item.description: The St. Louis Cardinals have traded all-star second baseman Brendan Donovan to the Seattle Mariners as a part of a three-team deal involving the Tampa Bay Rays.

item.title: Lawmakers consider bills on 7-OH and intoxicating hemp products
item.description: Missouri lawmakers are considering legislation that would clamp down on two intoxicating substances that have popped up in retail locations across the state.

item.title: Police make arrest after Warrenton officer struck by vehicle
item.description: Authorities in Warren County are searching for the individuals who struck a police officer with a car during a traffic stop Sunday morning. The officer was not injured, but the three suspects abandoned their vehicle and ran from the scene.

item.title: Services planned for 23-year-old who fell in frozen pond
item.description: Funeral arrangements have been announced for the 23-year-old man identified as the victim who fell into a frozen pond while saving his dog last week in New Baden, Illinois.

item.title: Former MICDS coach admits sending lewd pics to students
item.description: A former high school basketball coach appeared in federal court on Monday and admitted sending sexually explicit photos to students and having lewd or lascivious conversations with them.

item.title: City officials seek answers after Justice Center death
item.description: St. Louis city officials are calling for answers following another death at the City Justice Center, the latest in a series of deaths at the facility over the past five years.

item.title: Woman fatally shot after verbal dispute in West St. Louis
item.description: Commanders and Force detectives from the St. Louis Metropolitan Police Department (SLMPD) are responding to a shooting involving a St. Louis officer in West St. Louis Monday evening.
